primary_comparison: FIXED K50 versus IC_SHRUNK K50 per strategy
secondary_comparison: all five K in both variants, K20 preregistered observation focus; no automatic best-K selection

ic.statistic: daily pairwise-complete Spearman Rank IC of the production-preprocessed factor
ic.universe: each strategy's historically eligible universe, never today's survivors
ic.label: adjusted_close[d+6] / adjusted_close[d+1] - 1; no quote filling
ic.maturity: label exit date strictly earlier than weekly signal date
ic.weight_rule: within each family: 0.5 equal + 0.5 normalized positive trailing mean IC; no ICIR, sign flip, or extra temporal smoothing
ic.fallback: entire family equal if any component has insufficient IC history, or all mean ICs nonpositive; single-component families always 1
ic.family_budgets: five categories remain 20 percent each; focused value/growth each use one family
ic.overlapping_labels: 5-session daily outcomes overlap; 120 rows are not 120 independent observations; no naive significance claim

controls.schedule: last open session of completed W-FRI week; next open close execution
controls.common_dates: same 2011-2026 calendar, all arms start in cash; IC insufficient history falls back to FIXED and is reported
controls.insufficient_names: if either variant scores fewer than 50 names, both variants and all K hold that signal; report every skip
controls.benchmark: own PIT eligible universe equal-weight, same signal dates and cost model

execution: reuse prior validated fractional-share adjusted-price research replay, not integer-lot live simulation
limitations: already-seen history; not an independent unseen holdout or live approval
current provider financial snapshot by announcement date, not original vintage archive
historical industry interval taxonomy coverage incomplete
cash flow factor remains ocfps/close proxy, not true free cash flow
minimum fees, stamp tax history, lots, market impact, full suspension and price-limit execution not simulated
missing quotes block fills and carry prior marks; terminal stranded positions zero-value sensitivity must be reported
do not change daily forward accounts or choose a winner by full-sample maximum return
